notes.title: DSX v3.1 BETA 1.45 released. Check out what's new!
notes.content:
If you encounter any bugs or issues, reporting them to our Discord server will be the best way to get the support you need. [url=https://discord.gg/PUThpCFByn]Join our Discord server[/url]

[h3][b]BETA 1.45 Release Notes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]APP:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated all language files with addition of British English.
[*]Fixed DSX Launcher popup since not shutting down fast enough.
[*]Fixed Button Achievements alert showing each time you press a button.
[*]Numerous fixes and optimizations to ensure a smoother app experience.
[/list]
[h3]Input System:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Button MappingToggle sometimes not working correctly if multiple bindings are set.
[*]Fixed High CPU usage bug with keyboard mappings.
[*]Input System improvements.
[*] Added Input Extended Section in Controller Mapping page under the Controller View with Touchpad Gestures/Sticks inputs:
[list]
[h3]Touchpad Gestures:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Total of 7 different Sections: [b]Full Touchpad[/b], [b]Left/Right Sides[/b], [b]Top Left[/b], [b]Top Right[/b], [b]Bottom Left[/b], and [b]Bottom Right sides[/b]. Available Gestures for these sections:
[*]Single Press, Single Press Hold, Single Press Drag
[*]Tap, Tap Hold
[*]Swipe Left, Swipe Right, Swipe Up, Swipe Down
[*]Rotate Clockwise or Counter-Clockwise (Multi-Touch 2 Fingers Full Touchpad)
[*]Pinch (Multi-Touch 2 Fingers Full Touchpad)
[*]Zoom (Multi-Touch 2 Fingers Full Touchpad)
[*]More coming soon like [b]Double Press[/b], [b]Triple Press[/b],  [b]Double Tap[/b], [b]Triple Tap[/b], separate [b]Clockwise[/b]/[b]Counter-Clockwise rotation[/b], [b]Swipe Up Right[/b], [b]Swipe Up Left[/b], [b]Swipe Down Left[/b], [b]Swipe Down Right[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Left/Right Joysticks:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Up, Down, Left, Right
[*]Up Right, Up Left
[*]Down Left, Down Right
[/list]
[*]More non-Controller View inputs coming in the future to support PSVR 2 Sense custom inputs, Access Controller Custom Inputs, and others.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Previous silently pushed patches:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Virtual DualSense vibration issue.
[*]Added Motion to Controller Buttons.
[*]Added OSC Server usable via Outgoing UDP for OSC under Networking Tab in Settings Page.
[*]Fixed GOG installed game finding access denied.
[*]Added CemuHook protocol with option to send it physical or virtual controller buttons configurable via My Controller Page under General Settings. Make sure UDP out is enabled under Networking Tab in Settings Page.
[*]Updated General Settings UI in My Controller Page.
[*]Minor improvements and adjustments.
[/list]

[h3]Your thoughts help us make DSX even better—if you’ve got a minute, a quick Steam review would mean a lot.[/h3]

[h3][b]BETA 1.44 Release Notes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]APP Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[h3]Branding & UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated DSX logo/icon to a simplified white D‑Pad.
[*]Refined DSX setup and improved launcher handling (including better admin rights handling).
[*]Updated “Dark UI cards” to a lighter, more modern look.
[/list]
[h3]Core Improvements & Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced app settings loading and window focus on startup.
[*]Fixed issues with logging—corrected DLC ownership status logging and improved cache logs.
[*]Resolved a background hang in Device Manager caused by an awaited Task never completing.
[*]Fixed the Internet connection check loop when the two‑week cache expires with no connection.
[*]Updated DSX.Steam and Launcher projects with numerous bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Achievements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with updating local achievement files.
[*]Resolved a bug that froze the app during achievement syncing on repeated splash screen invocations.
[*]Fixed a crash in DSX.Steam during SteamAPI shutdown when a callback timer was still active.
[*]Corrected data parsing in UpdateStat and enhanced logging between DSX and DSX.Steam.
[/list]
[h3]DSX Console Companion App:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Completely rebuilt the DSX Console with a modern GUI and support for multi‑command handling.
[/list]
[h3]Controller Manager:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed duplicate entries in the controllers’ JSON configuration file.
[/list]
[h3]Physical & Virtual Devices:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed DS4 motion data issues and corrected inverted DS4 emulation rumble values.
[*]Numerous enhancements in processing data sent to physical devices.
[/list]
[h3]Controller Mapping Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Redesigned multiple UI sections for improved navigation.
[*]Added options to select gyro/accelerometer modes for dual‑stick operation.
[*]Introduced UI adjustments for right stick pitch (X‑axis) settings.
[*]Implemented auto‑enabling of Z‑axis when accelerator mode is activated.
[*]Added options to disable output X/Y axes in both shortcuts and motion mode settings.
[*]Added a “None” option for touchpad/joysticks/motion sensitivity activation.
[*]Introduced Stick‑To‑Controller Buttons mode.
[/list]
[h3]Haptics | Rumble Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed redundant max rumble limits and haptic intensity settings (intensity now controlled via separate sliders for left motor, right motor, and speaker/headset).
[*]Implemented Audio‑to‑Rumble with selectable sound source and a digital/analog detection test.
[*]Enhanced digital audio processing for Audio‑to‑Haptics.
[*]Fixed audio haptics issues when using the controller’s sound device (bad looping resolved by muting speaker/headset).
[/list]
[h3]Home Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed quick action updates so that virtual device selection no longer triggers errors.
[/list]
[h3]LED Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Redesigned with a new color picker.
[*]Updated battery LED animations with two modes (gradient colors and current battery level).
[*]Added a warning card for non‑DualSense controllers regarding DualSense LED features.
[/list]
[h3]Installed Games Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added new list and grid views for installed games.
[*]Fixed an issue where renaming a game profile didn’t update all games assigned to that profile.
[/list]
[h3]Virtual Device Options Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added DualSense (Audio Device) selection on both the Home and Virtual Device Options pages (requires an updated VirtualPad Driver coming at a later date).
[*]Introduced new haptics modes for virtual devices with audio (Disabled, Haptics‑to‑Rumble with gain, and Haptics Passthrough).
[*]Made the live data feed for virtual devices manually enabled.
[/list]
[h3]My Controller Page (Previously Controllers Page):[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved the raw motion data UI.
[*]Added a green screen feature for enhanced live raw feedback.
[/list]

[h3][b]BETA 1.41 Release Notes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]APP Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Farewell DSX v2[/b]: DSX v2 is no longer included with v3. A heartfelt goodbye to the version that helped shape the future of DSX. Thank you, DSX v2! <3
[*][b]Enhanced Ownership Verification[/b]: Improved ownership verification processes for both the Base App and DLC, ensuring smoother and more reliable access.
[*][b]Improved Launcher Communication[/b]: The Launcher now uses a new and more reliable method to launch DSX, enhancing stability and performance.
[*][b]Enhanced Error Logging[/b]: Introduced an Exception Enricher to significantly improve the readability of logged errors and crashes, making it easier to identify and fix bugs.
[*][b]New Language Support[/b]: Added Hebrew and Yiddish to DSX. All translation files for other languages have also been updated. Added fallback image for languages.
[*][b]Dismiss Alerts[/b]: Added a convenient dismiss button to alerts for a better user experience.
[*][b]Bug Fixes and General Improvements[/b]: Numerous fixes and optimizations to ensure a smoother app experience.
[/list]
[h3]Achievements:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Freeze Issue Resolved[/b]: Fixed an issue where DSX would freeze when navigating to the Achievements page if the user had no unlocked achievements.
[*][b]Steam API Integration[/b]: Updated the DSX.Steam companion app to correctly fetch achievement data via the Steam API.
[/list]
[h3]DSX Console Companion App:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Compile Fixes[/b]: Improved the compilation process and updated the program’s placement. It now resides in its own folder alongside DSX for better organization.
[*][b]New Command[/b]: /listProfiles: Enables users to list all available controller profiles quickly and easily.
[*][b]New Command[/b]: /listDevices: Allows users to view all connected controllers and their MAC addresses for better device management.
[*][b]New Command[/b]: /silent: Added the option to hide the console window using the /silent command for a cleaner, distraction-free experience.
[/list]
[h3]Button Mappings Page:[/h3]
[list]
[h3]Action System:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Motion Axis Toggle Shortcut[/b]: Added the ability to toggle the use of specific axes (X, Y, Z) across all Motion-to modes, providing quick and precise control over motion behavior without the need to adjust your main settings.
[/list]
[h3]Motion:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Axis Toggles[/b]: Users can now toggle the X, Y, and Z axes on or off for all motion modes, offering more precise control.
[*][b]Override by Real Stick[/b]: This feature can now be toggled on for any Motion-to-Joystick mode. When enabled, motion will not affect stick movement if you're physically moving the stick, allowing for better control and customization.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Haptics | Rumble Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Audio-to-Haptics Fix[/b]: Resolved an issue where Audio-to-Haptics would activate unexpectedly when connecting a controller via USB while in rumble mode.
[/list]
[h3]Installed Games Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Steam Game Detection Fix[/b]: Resolved an issue where Steam games were not being detected due to recent changes in how Steam saves files locally.
[*][b]External Program Support[/b]: You can now add external programs by specifying their name, executable file path, arguments, and type. These programs can also be edited or deleted as needed for complete customization.
[*][b]GoG Galaxy Integration[/b]: DSX now detects GoG Galaxy games, allowing you to assign game profiles and set multiple executable paths for flawless game detection and tracking.
[*][b]Multiple Executable Support[/b]: Added the ability to set multiple executable paths for all detected games and external programs, enhancing flexibility and accuracy.
[*][b]Improved Detection & Tracking[/b]: Enhanced methods for detecting and tracking playtime for non-Steam games and external programs, ensuring a more seamless experience.
[/list]
[h3]LED Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Mute LED Crash Fix[/b]: Resolved a crash that occurred when changing Mute LED microphone settings without a controller attached.
[/list]

notes.content:

[h3][b]BETA 1.40 Release Notes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]APP Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Screen Reader Accessibility: Initial support for screen readers has been added to improve accessibility. (Work in progress for full app compatibility.)
[*]Badge Alert Update: In-app badge alerts now align with the priority-based alert style.
[*]Software Rendering Option: Added the ability to use software rendering instead of hardware rendering. This allows the GPU to focus on gaming performance. Configure this in Settings -> Behavior -> Use Software Rendering
[*]Improved first time setup
[/list]
[h3]Achievements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sync Improvements: Resolved syncing issues between DSX and the Steam API.
[*]Keymaster Achievement: Added the missing Keymaster Achievement to the Achievements Page.
[/list]
[h3]Action System:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Profile Shortcuts Update: Added a Cycle Profiles option to Profile Shortcuts. Note: Further updates are needed to ensure this option applies consistently across all profiles for seamless cycling.
[/list]
[h3]DSX Console Companion App:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dependency Fixes: Fixed issues causing the app to fail due to missing dependencies.
[*]Help Commands: Improved formatting for the help command outputs.
[/list]
[h3]Motion Enhancements:[/h3]
[list]
New Motion Features:
[list]
[*]Motion-to-Mouse.
[*]Motion-to-Left Joystick.
[*]Motion-to-Right Joystick.
[*]Motion-to-Both Joysticks.
[*]Motion-to-Keyboard.
[/list]
[*]Axis Customization: Added options to invert X, Y, and Z axes and swap between X-Y, X-Z, and Y-Z axes.
[*]Gyro Data Improvements: Enhanced gyro data handling for virtual DualShock 4 and DualSense controllers.[/list]
[h3]Button Mappings Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Joystick Deadzones: Added visual horizontal and vertical lines to indicate joystick deadzones.
[*]Flick-Stick Mode: Implemented joystick-to-flick-stick mode for each joystick.
[*]Auto-Hold Mode: Motion-to-Mouse and Joystick-to-Mouse now support Auto-Hold Mode, allowing Left or Right Mouse buttons to stay pressed during movement for games requiring click-and-move aiming.
[*]Shortcuts: Added joystick-to-flick-stick and all motion-to-x shortcut modes.[/list]
[h3]Controllers Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Touchpad Feedback Fix: Resolved app freezing and crashing issues when viewing raw feedback for the touchpad.
[*]Motion Fix: Addressed motion update issues to ensure values refresh properly.
[/list]
[h3]Home Page:[/h3]
[list]
 Redesign: Updated layout when a controller is connected, introducing:
[*]Improved controller status and selection.
[*]Quick controller actions for profile changes, emulation mode adjustments, and preset modifications—without leaving the Home Page.
[*]Added app-related info, including a "What’s New" changelog and DLC details.
[/list]
[h3]Installed Games Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Game Detection: Improved detection of games for Game Profiles.
[*]Focus-Based Profile Switching: Added an option to change profiles when a game window gains focus.
[*]Game Profile Icon: Added a Game Profile Attached icon on game covers to visually indicate which games have an attached Game Profile.
[*]Persistent Filters: Filter options are now saved to app settings, ensuring your preferences are retained even after restarting the app.
[/list]
[h3]Mod System Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Mod Added: Control Ultimate Edition has been included in the mod list.
[/list]
[h3]Virtual Device Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Double Input Fix (Experimental): Introduced an option to fix double input issues. This feature attempts to restart the controller while keeping it in the HidHide list. It addresses cases where a controller cannot be hidden due to interference from other programs or games.
[/list]

[h3][b]BETA 1.38 Release Notes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]APP:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Controller Disconnect Fix: Resolved an issue where controllers would not disconnect on exit when the option was enabled in settings.
[*]Startup Stability Improvements: Addressed a rare issue that caused the app to display a completely white screen on startup, rendering it unusable.
[*]Steam User Info Caching: Steam user data, such as avatar images and Steam IDs, is now cached locally. This ensures the UI to look as expected even if the Steam API encounters connectivity issues.
[*]UDP Data Display Fix: Resolved an issue where live incoming UDP data was not displayed correctly if the data sent to DSX was improperly formatted.
[/list]
[h3]Achievements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated Achievement Unlocking Process: Automatic unlocking of achievements via the Steam API now occurs during the app's startup instead of instantly. To view your unlocked achievements in the Steam Client, please restart DSX.
[/list]
[h3]Action System:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Use Random Values Feature: Introduced a toggleable Use Random Values option for Turbo. When enabled, the delay and duration values are randomly selected within the specified minimum and maximum limits, offering a more dynamic and varied activation experience.
[/list]
[h3]Audio To Haptics:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Buffer Reset Enhancement: Implemented automatic buffer resets every 10 seconds to address potential delays or drifts experienced by some users.
[/list]
[h3]DSX Console Companion App:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Framework Downgrade: The app has been downgraded to .NET 4.7.2, resolving compatibility issues when invoked via the command line.
[*]Help Command Added: Introduced a Help command to display a list of available commands for easier usage.
[*]Runtime Dependency: The console will now only function when DSX is actively running.
[/list]
[h3]DualShock™ 4 USB Wireless Adapter | DualShock™ 4 v2:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Audio System Support: Added audio system support for DS4 v2 and DS4 dongle when connected via USB.
[*]Easy Configuration: The audio system can now be configured in the Controllers Page under General Settings → Audio System.
[*]Flexible Output Options: Users can set the audio output mode to Speaker, Headphones, or both.
[*]Enhanced Audio Controls: Added options to adjust volume levels for the speaker, left headset channel, right headset channel, and microphone.
[/list]
[h3]Input System:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mapping Enhancements: Improved functionality for button, keyboard, and mouse mappings that utilize Turbo or Toggle features.
[/list]
[h3]LED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Issue of LED not applying if emulation is set to Native Mode with Send Data to Device toggled OFF, and then turning it ON.
[/list]
[h3]Profiles:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Profile Name Update Fix: Resolved an issue where profile names would not update if a profile switch action was active.
[*]Shortcut Profile Switching: Switching a device profile via shortcuts now updates the UI with the new profile when the device is selected.
[*]Save/Delete Issue Fixed: Addressed a problem where saving or deleting a profile with a name mismatch between the profile and file name caused errors. The profile path is now used to track mismatched profile and file names, with added protection to ensure the user’s file path is not exposed when sharing profiles.
[*]Improved Import/Duplicate Naming: Importing or duplicating profiles no longer adds a “- Copy” suffix; numbers are now appended to the profile name instead.
[/list]
[h3]Button Mappings Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Joystick-to-Scroll Feature: Added functionality to use a joystick for scrolling, similar to the middle mouse button.
[*]Joystick-to-Keyboard Mapping: Introduced a new feature allowing joysticks to emulate keyboard input with three modes: WASD, Arrow Keys, and Numpad.
[*]Improved Joystick Shortcuts: Joystick shortcuts now function as toggles—press the assigned button once to activate and press again to deactivate.
Controllers Page:
[*]Alias Name Crash Fix: Resolved a potential crash that could occur when updating a controller's alias name.
[*]DS4 Information Display Fix: Corrected an issue where information for DS4 controllers was not displayed properly.
[/list]
[h3]Haptics/Rumble Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Haptics-to-Rumble Feature: Introducing a new Haptics to Rumble feature, which converts audio played on your PC into vibrations. It includes four modes: Haptics, Games, Movies, and Music. This feature aims to target the upcoming Virtual DualSense functionality, which provides a virtual sound device to enable haptics to be translated into rumble for wireless usage. It’s particularly useful for natively supported games that lack rumble fallback. It can still be used for other things similar to how Audio to Haptics work. (Note: This feature is still under development but already offers an exciting and immersive experience.)
[*]Haptic Modes Disconnect Fix: Fixed an issue where haptic modes would not stop when the device disconnected.
[/list]
[h3]Installed Games Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Gameplay Stats Issues: Resolved issues with displaying Last Played, Time Played, and Time Played (last 2 weeks) for Epic Games and third-party Steam games.
[*]Game Profile Application Fix: Corrected a bug where applying a game profile would fail if no game was selected.
[*]Critical File Search Issue Fixed: Addressed a potential issue where searching for a required file could result in it not being found, which is essential for detecting installed Steam games.
[*]Backend Performance Optimization: Improved loading and saving to cache, significantly enhancing performance and reducing memory usage during game searches or stat updates.
[*]Efficient Game Detection: Implemented a new, performance-focused method to detect if games are running.
[*]Seamless Game Profile Activation: Game profiles now activate automatically without requiring a visit to the Installed Games Page first.
[*]New Profile Restoration Option: Added an option to restore the previously used profile after a game is closed. This ensures the last active profile is reapplied when the game is no longer detected as running.
[*]Added a total games count next to the search bar.
[*]Introduced a new filter for Steam Third Party games.
[*]Added a filter to handle duplicates from different platforms (e.g., Epic Games Store and Steam Third Party). If unchecked, games with the same name or executable path will exclude duplicates from the list. (Note: This only affects the displayed game list, not game detection.)
[*]DSX is now listed among installed games; however, starting it, adjusting its executable path, or assigning a game profile remains disabled.
[/list]
[h3]Mod List Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Image Loading and Caching Fixes: Resolved various issues related to loading and caching images, ensuring smoother performance and reliability.
[/list]
[h3]Profiles Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rename Profile Fix: Resolved an issue where the Enter key did not work when renaming a profile.
[*]Improved Deletion/Reset Behavior: Updated the confirmation process for deleting or resetting a profile to display within the same card, replacing the previous popup for a smoother and less intrusive experience.
[/list]
[h3]Virtual Device Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Virtual Keyboard Settings: Introduced a dedicated section for Virtual Keyboard settings. Users can now configure the repeat speed for keyboard mapping actions when holding a button. Options include:
[*]Do Not Repeat: No key repetition.
[*]Slow Repetition: Slower repeat speed.
[*]Fast Repetition: Faster repeat speed.
[*]Native Keyboard: Mimics the natural behavior of a physical keyboard.
[/list]

notes.title: DSX v3.1 Beta is now out!
notes.content:
[h3]DSX v3.1 Beta is Here![/h3]
Hey everyone! After months of hard work, testing, and tons of feedback from private beta, this version is packed with features and is ready for you to explore!

[h3]Since the last post, here are important changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Upgraded DSX to .NET 8 which is faster and better for performance and memory management
[*]Notification Alerts within DSX, when unlocking achievements or changing scale size. More things will get added that are important.
[*]Added third party Steam game detections (non-steam game)
[*]Added Epic Games Store support. You can launch and view the store page directly from within DSX.
[*]Added Mod System list of supported mods.
[*]Audio to Haptics [list]
[*]You can now adjust the Speaker/Headset volume which are channel specific and is separate from the master speaker volume in Controllers Page
[*]Implemented Audio Mixing which further enhances Audio To Haptics: Customize your sound with flexible EQ options: choose OFF for original audio, 3-Band EQ for basic adjustments, 6-Band EQ for finer control, or Dynamic EQ for real-time automated tuning that target 3 dynamic modes: Games, Music, and Movies.
[*]Outgoing channels like Speaker, Headset, Left Motor, and Right motor can be disabled from being sent to the controller
[/list]
[*]Implemented Joystick Swapping: Swap the left and right joysticks being sent to the virtual device.
[*]Implemented Toggle support for mappings
[*]Actions can now be set for DS Edge Trigger Stops: Long, Medium, and Short.
[*]Added Audio System in Controllers page to control things like the output type (speaker/Headset), Input Type (Built-in/Headset) mic, Echo and noise cancellation. Speaker, headset, and Mic volume adjustments. Only works for USB DualSense variant devices.
[*]Added keyboard shortcuts for scaling the window with Ctrl + and Ctrl -.
[*]Save up to 20 custom Haptics/Rumble setups per profile.
[*] And More...
[/list]

[h3]How to Access the BETA?[/h3]
Switch Beta branch to [b]dsx_v3.1_beta[/b] in your DSX properties in your steam library.
Instructions here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3330635677
NOTE: You might have to restart steam for it to show up.

[h3]Issues? Feedback?[/h3]
Help report them to us in the DSX [url=https://discord.gg/PUThpCFByn]discord[/url] server to make things better for everyone!


More info about v3.1:

[h2]What’s New in DSX v3.1?[/h2]
[h3]Completely Revamped Profile System[/h3]
Profiles now save with a .dsx file extension, making them easy to manage and share right from File Explorer. Plus, they’re no longer tied to a specific device, meaning you can set up and tweak profiles without even having a controller connected.

notes.title: DSX v3 Beta | Optional Virtual DualSense Emulation DLC
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I want to talk a bit about DSX v3 and DualSense Emulation moving forward, DSX v3 has been in development for the past few months, that comes as a full app rebuild from scratch with so many new features and optimizations.

[h3]If you don't want to fully read this, there's a recap summery at the end of this post.[/h3]

For starters, v3 will be a [b]FREE UPGRADE[/b] to everyone once BETA is complete, this includes everything from v2 and new features implemented in v3.

Second, creating a Virtual DualSense Emulation in v3, will now require a DLC for its usage.

[b]Why a DLC?[/b]
Nefarius the developer of ViGEm Bus Driver, has spent over a year and countless hours in figuring out how to make a virtual DualSense  possible.

Of course anyone that would spend that much time researching and developing it, would not give up their tool for free, especially since there's nothing like it on the market.  No one currently is able to create a virtual DualSense until now with DSX v3.

[b]What does this DLC offer?[/b]
DSX v3 needs to have a beta no matter what, and instead of having a closed beta with a small group of people, teaming up with Nefarius in testing the DualSense Emulation, what better way to give everyone an equal chance to access the beta than a DLC for his work.

So, it will grant you early access to DSX v3 before everyone else, you'd be able to test out the latest features and help report any issues that may arise during testing and usage. This will lead to quick bug fixes and stabilization and optimizations.
 
Next, is the Virtual DualSense Emulation. There are games that natively support a physical wired DualSense 
connected to your PC with no support for Wireless features, or if you happened to have the DualSense Edge controller that a native game doesn't support, this DLC aims solve those issues.

As the games send data to the Virtual DualSense, DSX is able to get that info, and send it to your physical controller that is connected either Wired or Wireless. This is what info can be read as of this moment: [b]Adaptive Triggers | Light Bar |Player LEDs | Mic LED | Normal Rumble[/b]

[b]NOTE:[/b] Only the mentioned above are supported. Haptic Feedback is [b]NOT[/b] supported through a virtual DualSense controller, for clarafication, normal rumble will still work fine. Haptic Feedback will [b]NOT[/b] work wirelessly under any circumstances.

At the same time, YOU can control what the game sees by setting that up in DSX. You can remap the buttons however you like and the game will see exactly that, adjust deadzones, and more...

Once Beta is complete, having ownership of this DLC will serve as the key that simply unlocks the capability of creating a Virtual DualSense Device within DSX v3.

So by getting this DLC, you support Nefarius in researching, developing, being able to maintain ViGEm, and update it regularly to support new features in the future. It's thanks to him that this is now possible.

[b]Release Date:[/b]
DSX v3 BETA and this DLC will launch once the beta is in a ready state. 

[b]Pricing for this DLC:[/b]
Will be reasonably priced for a feature that isn't available anywhere else. 

[b]About the BETA:[/b]
Beta will run until DSX is stable and optimized from user feedback, while also finishing up implementing features not fully ready.

[b]Recap:[/b]
● v3 will be a free upgrade for everyone after BETA is complete.
● The DLC takes **nothing** away from existing features.
● Ability to create a Virtual DualSense Emulation device through DSX v3. (Main Highlight)
● DLC Will be priced fairly and below the cost of the app itself.
● Beta will run until app is stable and optimized and features fully implemented.

notes.title: DSX Rebuild v3.0.0 Haptic Feedback Modes First Look
notes.content:
Hope everyone has been enjoying using DSX as much as i have been developing it! This is a first look at Haptic Feedback and HidHide in v3.0.0. Like before, Haptic Feedback currently only supports a USB connection type.

[h3][b]Haptic Feedback[/b][/h3]
There will be 5 output modes to choose from:
[list]
[*][b]Standard Rumble (USB) (BT)[/b]
- The Current normal rumble built in from the controller.
[*][b]Audio Haptics (USB)[/b]
- Sends your system wide audio to the controller and turns it into Haptics.
[*][b]Rumble To Haptics (USB)[/b]
- Lets you turn incoming rumble values from an emulation device and translate it into haptics.
[*][b]Button To Haptics (USB)[/b]
- Lets you feel haptics on button presses like X, Square, Triangle etc..
[*][b]Trigger To Haptics (USB)[/b]
- Lets you translate L2/R2 pressure presses into haptics. This is NOT an Adaptive Trigger.
[/list]

During internal testing, using [b]Rumble To Haptics[/b] has really been a game changer in games that make them more immersive than ever. It's as if the game naturally supports haptics.

What you see from the video below is more for internal testing, however in the future, there will be presets to choose from for each mode using the different audio signal wave types. 

There will also be a mode where you can manually create your own preset like in the video using the different signal wave types and your desired frequency and intensity.

[h3][b]HidHide Integration[/b][/h3]
I've been in close contact with the developer who made HidHide, working together along side other devs to get HIdHide properly integrated in DSX and other Apps.

You will be able to see the list of applications in the whitelist who are able to access the physical controller as well as the devices list which determine which device can be hidden from games and other applications. You will be able to remove from either list. 

Without further ado, here's what it looks like below:

[previewyoutube=UPJw-e-WS7A;full][/previewyoutube]


Please consider Subscribing to my YouTube channel if you would like to see me post more videos like this!

Join the Discord Server to get the latest updates and previews regarding this rebuild.
https://discord.gg/PUThpCFByn

As of yet, there's no current ETA for when v3.0.0 will come out. Targeting by end of the year, but that will all depend on how much is implemented.

Hope you enjoyed reading this update, stay tuned for more updates to come in the future.
- Paliverse

notes.title: (Important read) All Steam API features to be removed from DSX
notes.content:
It's been an amazing/wild first couple days of DSX launching on Steam. There are important things to talk about that can't be ignored like the now playing status, controller not working in games etc..

[h2]Now Playing Status[/h2] 
I understand people's frustration with their steam profile showing "Playing DSX" when they don't want it to be shown or visible since this is a software app after all.

[h2]Steam API[/h2] 
The use of the Steam API for Workshop, Achievements, and Leaderboards has caused an issue with games not being able to recognize the controller anymore. The issue is on Steam's side since somehow it's choosing DSX for steam input even though it could be disabled. Not really sure where the fault is.

[h1]Solution:[/h1]

DSX will have a launcher that would open the app, after about 10 seconds, DSX Now playing status is gone.

Even though Workshop, Achievements, and leaderboards will no longer be available, there are many benefits to this solution after doing some tests:

- No more "Playing DSX" Status
- Users will no longer have to disable Steam Input or Overlay in DSX Properties
- (Most important) No more issues with games where input would just stop working
- Less ram usage since less UI components

[b]It's unfortunate to see them go, since I spent a lot of time implementing and working on these API features :( 
[/b]
[h2]When will this update come out?[/h2]
It will take a few days to fully remove most of the api, UI components, and the code from within the app. 

When it's ready it will be released ASAP.

notes.title: DSX Update v2.0.0 - Changes from the GitHub version
notes.content:
[h1]Update 2.0[/h1]

The new update will feature many new changes and added features from v1.4.9 (GitHub) shown below:

[h3]New Design[/h3]
DSX has been redesigned from the ground up to make the user experience much more fluid and enjoyable!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
A ton of bug fixes and improvements

[h3]Touchpad LED Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Static Color
[*]Rainbow
[*]Custom
[*]Breathing
[*]Strobing
[*]Battery
[/list] 
[h3]Adaptive Triggers[/h3]
[list]
[*]Applying Trigger modes have been separated for Left Trigger and Right Trigger
[*]Export Triggers implementation:
[list]
[*]Copy to clipboard
[*]Export for Textfile use
[*]Export for UDP use
[/list] 
[/list]
[h3]Controller Vibration[/h3]
Separated from Adaptive triggers list with two modes available:
[list]
[*]Time based - Choose your intensity and time up to 1,000 seconds
[*]Interval based - Choose your intensity/Interval and time up to 1,000 seconds
[/list] 
[h3]Games Tab[/h3]
Games Tab has a mod section with list of mods you can use that works with DSX through either UDP or Textfile method to talk with the controller to have dynamic Adaptive Triggers

[h3]Workshop Tab[/h3]
In a future update, users will be able to view the Workshop Tab to find adaptive trigger profiles submitted by other users, more on this later!

[h3]Stats Tab[/h3]
19 Fun Achievements like Travel Distance of Triggers, Number of button presses combined and more!

Stats Tab is all about viewing your stats and Achievements/Leaderboards.
Three Menus:
[list]
[*]Achievements - View your progress for unlocking all 19 Achievements.
[*]My Stats - View your current Trigger Distance and number of button presses
[*]Leaderboards (Coming in a later update) - View global ranking of Trigger Distance and number of button presses
[/list]

[h3]Shortcuts[/h3]
With shortcuts, you can manually open the Game Bar or turn off the DualSense Controller (BT)

[h3]HidHide[/h3]
HidHIde has now been integrated within DSX again to hide the physical controller

and a lot more...
